title: HelperFSWatchParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's watch op: one caller-minted id and one directory to follow. The id is the caller's because the caller is the party that must recognise its own notification after a connection is replaced, and it is the only handle unwatch takes — a path would have to be re-resolved against a host that may have moved, and two panels watching one directory would then share a fate neither asked for. No interval is carried: the host polls its own disk at the ladder the transport already owns (filesystem.WatchPollWait), and a caller-chosen rate would be a second owner of it.

id.description: The caller's identity for this watch, echoed on every `changed` notification it causes. Opaque to the helper: it is stored, compared and returned, never parsed.

path.description: The directory to follow, in the provider's path syntax. It must be a directory: a watch on a file or on a path that does not exist is the same refusal a list would answer (`not-dir`, `not-found`), decided before anything is installed.
